messages:
Samira: Quick kickoff for Lynx Health (trial). Goal: 30-day activation with search + chat pilot so we can generate a renewal signal. Short owners + risks below.

Ethan: I'll own SSO (SAML metadata + cert). Will request metadata now; escalate if no reply in 48h. :thumbsup:

Priya: I'll handle ingest & schema mapping. Need two sample exports and a field spec. If fields missing, we can shim but that's +2-3 dev days.

Luis: I'll own quotas, canary routing, and perf baseline. Proposing initial cap: 18 RPS, 2M tokens/day, burst to 36 RPS for 1 hour windows.

Marco: I'll run enablement (30-40m) Day 3 and post slides. Target attendees: PM + infra + analytics.

support-bot: Shared playbook: https://docs.redwood.internal/onboarding/lynx-playbook (view)

Samira: Compact checklist:
```
Day0: creds & billing (Samira)
Day1-3: export delivery + schema map (Priya)
Day3: enablement workshop (Marco)
Day4-9: SSO validation & smoke tests (Ethan)
Day7-14: canary + perf baseline (Luis)
Day14: NPS pulse & quality check (Samira)
Day21-30: go/no-go & renewal review (Samira)
```

Priya: Risk notes: missing fields -> shim (+2-3d). If SSO needs cert reformatting, eng-security assist may add 2 business days.

Luis: Success criteria suggestion: Activation = prod_queries >=100/day AND 90th_pct_latency <650ms by Day30. Renewal_signal = Activation AND usage_growth_7d >=10%.

Samira: Escalation: Day3 blocker -> @Samira + Solutions Eng. Day7 blocker impacting activation -> Director CS + Eng oncall. SSO >10d or schema unresolved >14d -> High renewal risk.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Lynx Trial - Weekly 30m" Wednesdays 10:30-11:00 PT Invitees: Samira, Ethan, Priya, Luis, Marco, Lynx PM.

Samira: I'll update the tracker with owners and dependency tags. Keep updates short in-thread; escalate per rules. Thanks all.
